newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Gazan dies from beating by PLO security forces. [CORRECTED 16:02 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Gazan dies from beating by PLO security forces. [CORRECTED 16:02 GMT]

text.p: A Palestinian man beaten unconscious by PLO security men last week died in hospital on Monday, a human rights group and doctors said.

"Prisoner Nasser Radwan died at 12:45 this afternoon...as a result of the wounds he sustained from the assault by members of Force 17 on June (corrects from March) 23," a statement by the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights said.

Radwan, 28, was the 13th Palestinian to die after being arrested since the Palestinian Authority took charge of parts of the West Bank and Gaza Strip in 1994 under a peace deal with Israel signed the previous year.

The Palestinian Authority has detained 10 police officers, including a colonel, in connection with the beating, a senior PLO police commander in Gaza said. He said President Yasser Arafat had ordered that officers involved in the incident be tried in a military court.
Palestinians said Radwan would be buried in Gaza on Tuesday.

The Islamic militant Hamas group, the main political organisation opposing the Palestinian Authority, called on Palestinians to turn Radwan's funeral into a massive "show of solidarity with the martyr's family and in opposition to giving security forces a free hand" against Palestinians.
